sections.title: Improving digital experiences at UW CoMotion
sections.summary: Designing and building web experiences that help researchers, entrepreneurs and industry partners discover innovation resources and navigate complex programs, from a new program website to a restructured patent guide and a resource library prototype.

sections.heading: Three projects that make complex content easy to find.
sections.lead: Each project took dense or scattered information and turned it into web pages that visitors can scan, navigate and act on.

pillars.text: Transforming program requirements into a navigable, scannable online experience.

sections.label: CASCADE program site
sections.heading: Designing a new program website.
sections.body:
A new program, CASCADE, needed to communicate its purpose, value, eligibility and opportunities to several audiences. The approach was a clear information hierarchy, with relevant components and navigation paths that help visitors find details.

The overview organizes eligibility, required materials and available technologies into distinct cards, so each audience can scan for what applies to them.
bullets: Scannable cards for each audience question

media.alt: CASCADE overview with three cards: Eligibility (Who can apply?), Materials (What do I need to submit?) and Innovations (What is available?)

sections.heading: One schedule, two ways to read it.
sections.lead: The visual timeline is paired with an expandable table format that offers a structured alternative. Both views communicate the schedule while supporting different reading preferences.

image.alt: Visual screening and program timeline with dated purple milestone markers
The same screening timeline as an expandable two-column table of dates and events

sections.label: Navigation and pathways
sections.heading: A direct path to each innovation area.
sections.body: A dedicated available-technologies subpage uses top-bar category links, so visitors can jump directly to the innovation areas they care about: medical devices, hardware, clean tech, agentic AI and health tech. Each technology entry combines a title, a concise description and a link to more details.

media.alt: Medical Devices section listing two technologies, each with an icon, title, short description and a Learn more button
CASCADE innovations page with category tiles for Medical Devices, Hardware, Clean Tech, Agentic AI and Health Tech

sections.caption: Category-level navigation: top-bar links take visitors straight to each innovation area.

sections.heading: Making dense content easier to navigate.
sections.lead: Patent-related material was reorganized into understandable web components. The process started with stakeholder conversations about priorities, then identified content categories and selected reusable web components.

a.heading: Dense source document
a.body: A dense source document made it difficult to find specific information quickly.

media.alt: Excerpt from the dense source document: long paragraphs defining inventorship, conception and joint inventorship

b.heading: Tabs for each topic
b.body: Definitions are grouped into labeled tabs, such as “Who is an inventor?” and “Positions & Titles,” to support topic-based navigation.

media.alt: Definition of inventorship section with tabs for Who is an inventor, Who is not an inventor, and Positions & Titles
Other important inventorship considerations shown as accordions, with Risks of incorrect inventorship expanded

sections.caption: Accordions reveal secondary considerations on demand to reduce visual overload.

sections.label: Resource library
sections.heading: Exploring a centralized resource library.
sections.body: Resources were scattered across the CoMotion website, and stakeholders wanted a centralized library organized into categories. Meetings with stakeholders covered target users, content types and presentation needs, alongside a review of existing design patterns. An early sketch explored how training content could be grouped and organized within the library.
bullets: Sidebar filters from the design system
Topic and media-type tags on cards

media.alt: Whiteboard sketch grouping innovation training and sessions into categories that branch into videos, readings and blogs
Resource library prototype with Topics and Media Type filters in a sidebar and resource cards tagged Video, Article and Podcast

sections.caption: The prototype reuses the existing design-system sidebar filter for familiar, consistent discovery, and shows topic and media-type tags on each card so visitors can judge relevance at a glance. [View the interactive Figma prototype](https://www.figma.com/make/BYG56KnidZ5o52gcKTtoWa/Polish-Resource-Library-UI?t=bvUZB8Ol79p8nwEq-20&fullscreen=1)
